card.name: Words just before a measured level
card.fires_on: Short words like maintain, from, peak, normal or pulse that come right before a measured value or monitoring term such as blood glucose, baseline, C-peptide or oximetry.

modes.label: maintain a level
modes.description: The verb maintain before a target blood or oxygen level.
modes.example: at a rate that will<< maintain>> the blood glucose at a level above

modes.label: change from baseline
modes.description: The word from after a threshold, before baseline or a reference measurement.
modes.example: QTc prolongation >500 msec or >60 msec<< from>> baseline Hold VONJO.

modes.label: measurement terms
modes.description: Words like peak, normal or pulse that lead into a lab value or monitoring method.

card.writes: It seems to push toward demographic and pulse-type terms, with no clear fit to the contexts.
